question: 设函数 $f(x) = \begin{cases} x, & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2 \\ 0, & x < 0 \text{ 或 } x > 2 \end{cases}$ ，试求二重积分 $\iint_{D} \frac{f(x + y)}{f(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2})} \mathrm{d}x \mathrm{~d}y$ ，其中 $D = \{(x, y) | x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 4\}$ .
answer: } & = \iint_ {D _ {1}} \frac {x + y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y + \iint_ {D _ {2}} \frac {x + y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y + \iint_ {D _ {3}} \frac {x + y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = 2 (\sqrt {2} - 1) + 2 \sqrt {2} \ln (1 + \sqrt {2}) + 2 (\sqrt {2} - 1) = 4 (\sqrt {2} - 1) + 2 \sqrt {2} \ln (1 + \sqrt {2}). \end

steps.text:
分析 积分区域为圆形区域适宜选极坐标积分. 只需在被积函数的非零区域内积分.

根据题意可得

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {f (x + y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} {x + y,} & {0 \leqslant x + y \leqslant 2,} \\ {0,} & {\text {其他}.} \end{array} \right.} \\ & {f (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} {\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}},} & {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 4,} \\ {0,} & {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} > 4.} \end{array} \right.} \end{array}
$$

被积函数的非零区域为： $D^{\prime} = \{(x,y)\mid 0\leqslant x + y\leqslant 2,x^{2} + y^{2}\leqslant 4\}$ ，则

$$
\iint_ {D} \frac {f (x + y)}{f \left(\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}\right)} d x d y = \iint_ {D ^ {\prime}} \frac {x + y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} d x d y.
$$

用坐标轴将区域 $D'$ 分为 $D_{1}, D_{2}, D_{3}$ （如图5.4所示）．用极坐标计算得

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \iint_ {D _ {1}} \frac {x + y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y & = \int_ {- \pi / 4} ^ {0} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {2} \rho (\cos \varphi + \sin \varphi) \mathrm{d} \rho \\ & = 2 (\sin \varphi - \cos \varphi) \Big | _ {- \pi / 4} ^ {0} = 2 (\sqrt {2} - 1); \end{array}
$$

meta.commentary:
评注 对二重积分，若满足下列条件之一，则适宜选极坐标计算：

\- 积分区域为圆形区域或其部分；

\- 积分区域的边界曲线用极坐标表示其方程比较简单；

\- 被积函数(或部分)形式为 $f(x^{2} + y^{2})$ 或 $f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$ .
